snippet.title: Busy Bar: World Tour - Official Gameplay Trailer | 1–4 Player Co-op Bar Management Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist Busy Bar: World Tour on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4743320/Busy_Bar__World_Tour/

Play the demo during Steam Next Fest: June 15–22, 2026.
Launches June 23, 2026.

Serve drinks. Survive ridiculous guests. Build your bar empire.

Busy Bar: World Tour is a chaotic arcade-management game for 1–4 players, playable solo or in local co-op. Run your inherited bar, slide drinks down the counter, recall empty glasses, collect tips, clean up spills, hire guests as AI barbacks, upgrade your venue, and buy out rival moguls across the world.

But your customers are not just walking orders.

Some guests fall asleep and block your lane. Some dance on the counter until drinks start smashing. Some steal your coins, change their order mid-shift, drop suspicious gifts, or even grab your bartender and throw them out the door.

Every shift is short, chaotic, funny, and rewarding — with no harsh fail states. You always earn something, improve something, and move one step closer to owning the next bar.

Key Features:
• 1–4 player local co-op on one shared screen
• Play solo, with friends, with AI barbacks, or mix them together
• 25 ridiculous guest types with unique abilities
• Hire guests as AI barbacks with different stats
• 21 bar locations worldwide
• Upgrade and personalize your bars with visible changes
• Steam Remote Play Together support
• No harsh fail states — every shift ends in progress

If you enjoy chaotic co-op games, casual management games, restaurant/bar games, or games like Overcooked and PlateUp!, add Busy Bar: World Tour to your Steam wishlist today.

Steam page + demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4743320/Busy_Bar__World_Tour/
